args: Focused complementary evidence for the selected lip sector. Request named depth points inner and outer on visible surfaces beneath the inward and outward open-finger neighborhoods, approximately 35-50 mm from the lip along the supplied radial axis, near its tangent center. Never measure a hidden surface. Request regions approach_eye and approach_agent, each with explicit camera, tight image box covering this entire projected open-finger envelope plus nearby obstacles, and stride=4. The crops are unsegmented evidence, not object masks. Use both views where possible. Inspect all of the envelope for occlusion, overhangs or nearby bottle/package/cabinet intrusion; visible_no_overhang means observed coverage only, not hidden-space certification. Reconfirm the support polygon is on the same clear cabinet top and the selected sector is the same bowl lip. Report the declared fields.

context.note: The envelope is centered at the selected lip; first coordinate is tangent and second is radial. No grasp, hidden clearance or route has been established.

result.explanation: The selected sector remains the lower-left lip of the patterned bowl in the wrist view. Inner and outer target visible bowl interior and counter, respectively, approximately 42 mm inward and outward along the supplied radial axis near its tangent center. The full projected envelope also overlaps the raised cooktop corner at its outward/tangential edge in both views. That is observed external intrusion and occlusion of the counter beneath it, not robot self-occlusion or a certified finger collision. No bottle, package, or cabinet intrusion into this local envelope is apparent. The support polygon remains on the same visibly clear cabinet top.

parameters.note: The two approach crops are unsegmented and include the entire projected local envelope and nearby obstacle portions. The outer center sample is clear counter despite the cooktop intrusion near the envelope edge. Point depths must be obtained from the selected visible surfaces; offsets are approximate pending depth. Cabinet support is visible in agentview, outside the wrist view. No hidden under-lip geometry, clearance for later motion, retention, or task completion is established.
